title: Phase A5 packed-package consumer and bundle verification

sourceOracles.coverage: Pinned public package import and export behavior.
Pinned browser and Web Worker bundle smoke gate.

independentValidation.method: npm pack --dry-run file-list inspection, temporary real tarball installation, self-package imports for every declared non-wildcard entrypoint and every concrete application wildcard, plus the existing browser/Worker esbuild smoke gate.
independentValidation.fixture: A temporary consumer project imports only package-name and declared subpath specifiers from the packed migration workspace.

tolerances.serializedParity: all packed imports resolve and expose non-empty public modules
tolerances.publicStrings: package identity, private flag, version, export targets and import specifiers are exact
tolerances.errors: missing dist files, private source-path imports, unavailable package exports or failed bundle smoke tests fail the gate

parityDifferences: The verification creates and removes only temporary pack and consumer directories; it does not publish, rename, tag or cut over the package.
The package remains private with version 0.0.0 and the migration-workspace name.
engineeringFunctionality: Executable packed-package and browser/Web Worker verification for the restored public package surface.
